Meta.homeDescription: An editorial view of Finnish employment pension funding: national-accounts asset stocks (Statistics Finland) and annual system flows (ETK)—what the measures are and how to read them carefully.
Meta.methodologyDescription: How we source, validate, and present pension funding data.
Meta.sourcesDescription: Primary references and datasets behind this story.

hero.title: How Finland’s pension system is funded
hero.lead: This page follows one official national-accounts series: the stock of financial assets held by employment pension schemes.
hero.framing: It is a balance-sheet lens on funding capacity—not a picture of benefits, contributions, or individual entitlements, and not a forecast.
hero.sourceLine: Statistics Finland · national financial accounts (RTP), sector S13141

fundingOverview.title: Why this measure matters
fundingOverview.lead: Statutory earnings-related pensions are partly backed by invested reserves. In the national accounts, those holdings appear as financial assets on employment pension schemes’ balance sheets.
fundingOverview.interpretation: The size of that asset stock is one way to see how large the system’s invested buffer has become over time. It answers a narrow question well: how big is this recorded reserve, year after year?
fundingOverview.bridge: The series runs from {firstYear} to {latestYear}; the chart below shows every year in the processed extract.
fundingOverview.attribution: Source: Statistics Finland, national financial accounts (RTP), sector S13141 employment pension schemes, instrument total financial assets (F0), million euros, year-end stock positions.

signatureViz.title: The signature series
signatureViz.seriesLabel: Employment pension schemes — total financial assets (national accounts)
signatureViz.deck: Each point is a year-end stock total in billions of euro, exactly as published for this sector and instrument in Finland’s national financial accounts.
signatureViz.takeaway: You are looking at a long arc of accumulated financial holdings on one institutional balance sheet—not annual cash inflows or outflows, and not the pension system’s full economic footprint.
signatureViz.ariaLabel: Line chart of employment pension scheme financial assets from {from} to {to}.
signatureViz.ariaLabelEmpty: Chart area: no series data available.
signatureViz.lineName: Total financial assets, employment pension schemes
signatureViz.readThisBody: Compare height between years: higher means a larger recorded asset stock at year-end. The dashed vertical line marks the latest year in this extract—useful as an anchor, not a prediction.
signatureViz.sourceNote: Data: Statistics Finland (RTP / 11qp), sector S13141, instrument F0. Figures can be revised as methods and source data are updated.
signatureViz.caption: National accounts are revised over time; the most recent year may be provisional. Axis labels are shortened for legibility; tooltips show one decimal.
signatureViz.emptyState: No chart data is available for this view.

fundingFlows.title: Annual flows in the earnings-related system
fundingFlows.intro: Eläketurvakeskus (ETK) publishes annual insurer-reported flows: premiums, pensions paid, and investment result. This complements the RTP stock chart above; how it differs from that series and what the narrow net means are spelled out in the note below the charts.

chartA.caption: Three lines, same scale: how large are premiums, investment results, and benefit outlays each year?
chartA.ariaLabel: Multi-line chart of annual premiums, investment result, and pension outlays from {from} to {to}.
chartA.ariaLabelEmpty: Chart area: no annual flow data available.
chartA.readBody: Higher premiums mean more contribution income in that year. Investment result can be negative when markets fall. Pensions paid are shown as a magnitude (billions out the door)—compare the three to see which components moved most in a given year.
chartA.emptyState: No flow series is available for this view.

chartB.caption: A narrow annual balance: premiums plus investment result, minus pensions paid
chartB.ariaLabel: Bar chart of derived annual net flow from {from} to {to}; bars above zero are positive years, below zero negative.
chartB.ariaLabelEmpty: Chart area: no net flow data available.
chartB.readTitle: What this net does (and does not) mean
chartB.readBody: Same formula as in the processed file: contributions + investment result − pensions paid, excluding other ETK lines. Orientation only—see the distinctions note below for limits.
chartB.emptyState: No net flow series is available for this view.

fundingFlows.caveatBody: ETK figures follow insurer reporting and differ from Statistics Finland RTP sector S13141 stock totals used in the signature chart. The narrow net is not a solvency measure. Latest years may be revised when financial statements are finalized.
fundingFlows.sourceNote: Flows: ETK tilastotietokanta, rahavirrat01_kaikki (institutions combined). Tooltips use one decimal; axis labels are shortened.

keyMetrics.title: Supporting context
keyMetrics.lead: Three reference points summarize the same processed series. They are descriptive, not prescriptive—useful for orientation alongside the line chart.
keyMetrics.howToReadAria: Guidance on reading the supporting figures
keyMetrics.howToReadBody: All values are stock positions from the same national-accounts extract. Growth compares the latest year to the first year in the series; it does not annualize returns or adjust for valuation effects.
keyMetrics.growthHint: Versus the first year in this series (ratio of totals).
keyMetrics.spanHint: Consecutive years in the processed series.
keyMetrics.notInference: What this does not mean: it is not a solvency verdict, not a replacement for scheme-level reporting, and not guidance for personal pension decisions.

storyTrust.title: Methodology and sources
storyTrust.intro: The goal is simple transparency: keep raw inputs separate from what you see on screen, and make it easy to verify what is being plotted.
storyTrust.methodologyBody: We document ingestion, validation, normalization, and the transforms that turn processed JSON into chart-ready view models—so the story stays auditable as it grows.
storyTrust.sourcesBody: The story uses two extracts: Statistics Finland RTP (11qp, sector S13141, instrument F0) for the asset stock line, and ETK rahavirrat01_kaikki for annual flows and the derived narrow net. Links and short descriptions are on the sources page.

MethodologyPage.title: Methodology
MethodologyPage.intro: The site uses a reproducible path: official PxWeb extracts are stored raw, validated, normalized into a processed JSON artifact, then transformed into chart view models. Fuller narrative methodology may be added later.
MethodologyPage.datasetsNote: The story page combines two processed extracts: Statistics Finland RTP (11qp, sector S13141, instrument F0) for the year-end asset stock line, and ETK rahavirrat01_kaikki for annual flows. The bar chart net is a narrow derived figure from the ETK file (contributions + investment result − pensions paid, excluding other lines); it is not a solvency indicator, and ETK flows are not interchangeable with RTP stock totals.

layers.validate: Validation — Zod schemas for raw and processed shapes
layers.normalize: Normalize — ordered annual series in million EUR
layers.processed: Processed — versioned JSON consumed by the app
layers.transform: Transform — view models for sections and charts

SourcesPage.title: Sources
SourcesPage.intro: Datasets used on the homepage story:
SourcesPage.statfinHeading: National financial accounts — employment pension assets
SourcesPage.statfinBody: Statistics Finland table 11qp (financial assets and liabilities, annual). Series: sector S13141 employment pension schemes, instrument F0 total financial assets, stock positions in million euros. Used for the signature asset stock line and supporting metrics.
SourcesPage.etkBody: ETK PxWeb table rahavirrat01_kaikki (pension assets and funding flows, million EUR): annual flow lines from supervised insurers, all institutions combined (code 399). Powers the story’s flow charts and the derived narrow-net bar chart—not the RTP stock series above.

Footer.note: Refresh assets: npm run ingest && npm run transform:data. Refresh funding flows: npm run ingest:funding-flows && npm run transform:data:funding-flows.
